doc.name: Click-to-Frame by Syscon Australia
doc.instructions: Click-to-Frame is interactive: call open_click_to_frame and let the user work in the app. It cannot edit images by itself.

tools.name: open_click_to_frame
tools.title: Open Click-to-Frame
tools.description: Opens Click-to-Frame, an interactive photo tool, inside the chat. The user picks a photo, taps a painting, screen, window or sign to turn it into a frame, and drops any picture inside it - people standing in front stay in front. It can also cut any tapped object out as a transparent PNG. Use it when the user wants to put a picture inside part of a photo, replace a painting or screen, or cut an object out. The work happens in the app, on the user's device; this tool returns no image.

task.description: Short description of what the user wants to do, shown to them in the app, e.g. 'put my dog photo into the painting'.
